items.title: Billie Pierce, De De Pierce, Israel Gorman, Joseph "Kid Twat" Butler Interview, 1963-11-20
items.q: Which him and I raised up together. Down on Verrett Street.

ctx.x: Yeah, I'll be 62 years old, I think, this Christmas. Not I think, I better be sure. Not 62, 57. 57. 57. I take that back, because I ain't ashamed to tell my age. And many bands on the road. Duke, Fletcher Henderson. I have played bass with him when the first thing they put the hatchet on the band. Red Allen time, he was playing with him in that time. Which him and I raised up together. Down on Verrett Street. Yeah, right across from the graveyard. He may yell this and he know this old twat talking. Well, in them…

items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1964-03-21
items.q: Louis Armstrong. Red Allen. We all played together.

ctx.x: Stop it Paul, she can't fix it. Okay. Alright. What's your name? My name is Joseph. That's not what everybody calls you. They call me Kid Twat from the Boothwaite.

Well where the Boothwaite come from? I was up in St. Paul, Minnesota. I left there. I came on down there to St. Louis. Where I was then. They used me. I was taken right from my own hometown. And then what they call me then? Kid Twat from the Boothwaite. Why they call me that? Because I was a cigarette tester. Cigarette tester. Where were you born? I was born right here on the next street. I was right there where I came out. In Algiers. Al J is right where I am young now. On the next street I'm on the Homer Street…
